name: v0.3.23 — branded app-bar typeface (Bricolage Grotesque) + GuacGreen receipt hero
releaseNotes:
• AppBar titles across the app now render in Bricolage Grotesque — a contemporary display grotesk with a 'Wonk' axis that gives letters a subtle off-square personality. Distinct from Fetch's neutral sans and from generic serifs.
• Receipt detail hero rebuilt away from the Fetch-look: GuacGreen emerald→lime gradient, store logo centered as the focal point (80px, white tile, ring), store name + total + date below it, smooth wave bottom edge (no more zigzag).
